issues.description: [suggestion] Add an "Eating out" quick-log mode on Nutrition: instead of exact food search, let user type/say a restaurant dish name (e.g. "Swiggy chicken biryani, medium") or pick from a curated India eating-out list (biryani, thali, dosa, pizza, momos, etc.) and get an AI-estimated calorie/macro range (with a +/- confidence note) logged as one entry. Problem: FAQ already tells users "estimate as best you can" for restaurant meals (src/lib/faq-fallback.ts) but there is no dedicated flow — users must force-fit takeout into the packaged-food/barcode/recipe search UI, which has no restaurant coverage, so eating-out days (very common for India users, Swiggy/Zomato culture) get skipped or badly mis-logged, breaking streak + daily-report accuracy. Evidence: grep across src/ shows barcode scanner, food-photo snap, and recipe search all exist for home/packaged food but zero restaurant/eating-out affordance; only mention of "restaurant" in the whole app is FAQ copy. v1 scope: one "Eating out" entry point on the Nutrition add-meal sheet -> free-text/voice input (useSpeechInput already exists) -> LLM estimates calories/macros with a visible "estimated" badge -> logs as a normal meal entry, no new backend tables (reuse existing custom-meal logging path). Effort: ~1-2 days FE (new sheet + prompt) + backend LLM prompt addition, no schema change.
issues.author: shakeebshaan

previousFix.description: Root cause: Quick Log had photo->AI estimate + voice + manual macros but no text->AI estimate, so eating-out/takeout dishes (Swiggy/Zomato) couldn't be quick-logged despite the FAQ promising it. Fix: new backend POST /ai/estimate-meal-text (mirrors the photo route; deployed + live) + an 'Estimate with AI - eating out?' action on CustomMealModal Quick Log that estimates calories/macros and shows an inline 'AI estimated - <confidence>' badge, logged via the existing path (no schema change).

judge.note: v1 scope met exactly: free-text/voice dish -> AI single-serving estimate -> visible estimated+confidence badge -> logged via existing custom-meal path, no schema change. Also fixes the FAQ promise (faq-fallback.ts:175). Verified end-to-end: prod endpoint live (biryani 600kcal), FE badge renders at 390x844, tsc clean, 0 console errors. Below 100 only because the broader curated India eating-out list is deferred beyond v1.

issues.description: [suggestion] One-tap "Repeat meal" on the Nutrition diary — long-press or a small repeat-icon on any past meal card re-logs the same food(s)/quantities to today with one confirm tap, instead of requiring the CustomMealModal. Problem: athletes eat the same breakfast/post-workout shake most days but must reopen the manual-entry modal, hunt the food again via search or the buried "Recent meals" chip row (CustomMealModal.tsx:514-533), and resubmit every time — friction that discourages consistent logging (the exact behavior daily-completion/streak scoring depends on). Evidence: repo scan confirmed barcode scan, water tracker, and streak-freeze already exist, but no true repeat-log exists anywhere in src/pages/Nutrition.tsx or src/pages/_components/nutrition/ — the closest is the modal's prefill-only "Recent meals" row, which still requires opening the modal and resubmitting. Comparable trackers (MyFitnessPal "Copy meal", Cronometer "Copy from previous day") ship this as a core retention feature. v1 scope: add a repeat icon/swipe action on each meal-diary row (today or yesterday) that calls the existing add-meal/log endpoint with the same food_items + quantities, no new backend route needed; skip cross-day "copy whole day" for v1. Effort: ~0.5-1 day FE-only (new button + reuse existing log-meal service call).
